# Vicoa

> Vicoa (Vibe Code Anywhere) lets you orchestrate dozens of coding agents in parallel, anywhere. Run Claude Code and other AI coding agents on any device — start on your laptop, switch seamlessly to mobile or web, get alerts when an agent needs input, and approve changes with one tap.

Vicoa connects coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) running on your machine to a mobile app and web dashboard, with real-time notifications and cross-device sync. The backend is the source of truth; web and mobile clients stay in sync over a unified messaging system.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://vicoa.ai): Product overview and how Vicoa works.
- [Features](https://vicoa.ai/features): Capabilities — cross-device coding, notifications, one-tap approvals.
- [Coding agents](https://vicoa.ai/coding-agents): Supported agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) and integration details.
- [Pricing](https://vicoa.ai/pricing): Plans and pricing.
- [Blog](https://vicoa.ai/blog): Product updates, guides, and announcements.
- [Updates](https://vicoa.ai/updates): Changelog of new features and improvements shipped to the app, web, and CLI.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://vicoa.ai/docs): What Vicoa is and how the pieces fit together.
- [Set up Vicoa](https://vicoa.ai/docs/getting-started): Install the CLI and connect your first machine.
- [Coding agents](https://vicoa.ai/docs/agents): Compare the supported agents and switch between them.
- [Claude Code](https://vicoa.ai/docs/agents/claude-code): Use Claude Code with Vicoa.
- [Codex](https://vicoa.ai/docs/agents/codex): Use Codex with Vicoa.
- [OpenCode](https://vicoa.ai/docs/agents/opencode): Use OpenCode with Vicoa.
- [Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, Kimi, Hermes](https://vicoa.ai/docs/agents/more-coding-agents): Additional agents available from the app and dashboard.
- [Claude Code vs. Codex](https://vicoa.ai/docs/claude-code-and-codex): Choosing a default agent and switching per session.
- [Start a remote session](https://vicoa.ai/docs/start-remote-session): Launch a session from mobile or web.
- [CLI commands](https://vicoa.ai/docs/cli-commands): List sessions with `vicoa ls` and stop them with `vicoa stop`.
- [Live preview](https://vicoa.ai/docs/live-preview): Expose a local dev server and open it on any device.
- [Free and alternative models](https://vicoa.ai/docs/alternative-models): Run Vicoa without a paid Anthropic account.
- [Features](https://vicoa.ai/docs/vicoa-features): Slash commands, permission modes, dictation, cross-device workflows.
- [Version compatibility](https://vicoa.ai/docs/version-compatibility): Which CLI and app versions work together.
- [Changelog](https://vicoa.ai/docs/changelog): Release history for the app and CLI.
- [Mobile app changelog](https://vicoa.ai/docs/changelog/mobile-app): iOS and Android releases.
- [CLI changelog](https://vicoa.ai/docs/changelog/vicoa-cli): CLI and daemon releases.
- [FAQ](https://vicoa.ai/docs/faq): Common questions about setup, pricing, security, and agents.
- [Troubleshooting](https://vicoa.ai/docs/troubleshooting): Fixes for install, connection, and startup problems.
